violations.why: Timer_Force_isr (priority 3) can preempt Timer_A_isr between the increment and the check. It resets timerCount to 0, so the check sees 0 instead of the incremented value.
The increment is a non-atomic read-modify-write. Timer_Force_isr can write timerCount between the read and the write-back, and the stale value then overwrites its update.
Timer_Force_isr can preempt Timer_B_isr after it sets timerCount to 1. Force sets it to 0, so the check at line 109 fails, which should be impossible.
